campaign: CHIMIE Femme - Orchard / Lychee / Freesia R1
claim: A source-bounded, weighable pear-led apple/lychee fruity-floral development hypothesis, not a reconstruction or a tested commercial winner.
parent_boundary: New campaign follows the user's newly locked pear/apple/lychee brief. PW2 is a historical pear/apple-only comparator, not a declared physical parent. No stock rebase or parent-equivalence pass is claimed.

brief.secondary_signature: fresh lychee; not a rose perfume
brief.heart: restrained cool freesia-like transparency with trace osmanthus
brief.base: pear-associated musk, restrained clean musk and pale warm wood
brief.reference_scope: Official marketed architecture only; no proprietary formula or authenticated bottle analysis.
reference_products: Guerlain Aqua Allegoria Pera Granita EDT
Jo Malone English Pear & Freesia Cologne
brief.richness_definition: Separate peel, juice, flesh, fine natural texture, integrated transitions and fruit-memory; never ingredient count or generic beauty score.

thirty_ml.option_1: Scale the complete 10 g composition uniformly, then fill exactly 30 mL after mixing and measuring at a stated temperature. Retain any excess.

simple_control.quantity_basis: Same 2.000 g product-equivalent target in 10.000 g finished batch
simple_control.carrier_match_rule: Calculate stock charges from these product percentages with the same per-product working stocks as R1. Add pure DPG and DEP to match R1's 0.40734 g DPG and 0.01080 g DEP, then bring finished mass to 10 g with the same perfumery alcohol. Compare exact recipes or record all rounding changes; do not claim exact measured carrier matching from a 1 mg balance.
simple_control.compensation: Hedione receives the removed product mass; it is not an odorless control. This comparison therefore tests whole architecture, not causally isolated richness or ingredient count.
